text:
Anya: Heads up — after the ap-south1 GPU node drain we saw a spike in "traces_missing" alerts and a bunch of short-lived requests with no trace attached. Grafana SLO panel is very noisy.
Sam: Seen it. Alerts started around 1967890105 when the autoscaler started cordoning nodes. TS of the alert in grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/trace-slo
Kevin: Quick theory — gateway is truncating large headers during fanout. We're encoding otel baggage into x-redwood-trace and some nodes hit the 8k header limit, nginx drops them.
Anya: Repro steps? can we curl through the gateway showing missing traceparent?
Kevin: repro with curl:
```
curl -v -H 'traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01' \
  -H 'x-redwood-trace: <very-long-base64>' \
  https://gateway.ap-south1.redwood.internal/health
```
 nginx logs show: "header too large, dropping" then request proceeds without trace headers.
Sam: Also noticed otel-collector sidecar logs with `exporter dropped spans: reason=missing_traceparent` around same time.
marta: I think this only spikes when node drains trigger many parallel reconnects (fanout blob is big). Short-lived requests get sampled out and we get missing parent -> bad for trace completion metrics.
deploy-bot: rollout/infra-gateway-v2 started 1967890060 by kevin
oncall-sre: Proposed mitigation: 1) reduce x-redwood-trace size by switching to compact binary header (followup PR), 2) tune ingress nginx large_client_header_buffers for gateway pods, 3) tweak prometheus alert to use missing_trace_fraction > 0.25 for 10m to avoid flapping. I'll own alert tweak.
Sam: Otel SDK change: we can stop sending full baggage to external services and only send traceparent + a tiny service-hint header. That reduces header length massively.
Anya: Can someone open a quick runbook PR and add steps for pre-drain tuning? assign kevin for nginx config, marta for SDK change, oncall-sre for alert change.
oncall-sre: I'll update prometheus rule in infra-alerts, set firing threshold to 10m. PR  https://github.com/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/482
Kevin: I'll test nginx large_client_header_buffers on staging and post results in #eng-infra, ETA today EOD.
marta: SDK PR linked: https://github.com/redwood/otel-sdk/pull/129 — adds compact header + opt-in.
Anya: Great. Closing loop: if noise persists after the changes we fallback to temporary sampling off for internal health pings.
